title: South Florida Halloween Costume Contests With Prizes
igCaption:
Costume contests with real prizes around South Florida this Halloween.
Oct. 31, South Florida, check each venue for entry details.

Sources: Secret Miami, Miami New Times, Owner-provided event details

#SouthFlorida #HalloweenWeekend #MiamiEvents #FortLauderdale

scenes.text: Dom’s in Brickell is giving the best-dressed guest a one hundred fifty dollar gift card this Halloween weekend.

Start with Dom’s in Brickell. The costume contest begins at five p.m. on October thirty-first, and guests in costume get a free tequila shot with purchase. The best-dressed guest wins a one hundred fifty dollar gift card.
scenes.caption: Start with Dom’s in Brickell. The costume contest begins at 5 p.m. on Oct. 31, and guests in costume get a free tequila shot with purchase. The best-dressed guest wins a $150 gift card.

scenes.text: Next door, DC Pie Co. gives kids twelve and under a free personal pizza with a purchase if they show up in costume. The pizzeria runs from noon to eleven p.m. on Halloween. If you’re there in costume, open NEAR and see who’s around.

scenes.text: Miami also gets Halloween on a Saturday this year. Miami New Times listed late-night parties across the city for October thirty-first, including costume contests, DJ sets, drink specials, and free admission at some stops.
scenes.caption: Miami also gets Halloween on a Saturday this year. Miami New Times listed late-night parties across the city for Oct. 31, including costume contests, DJ sets, drink specials, and free admission at some stops.

scenes.text: Which South Florida costume contest should people know about next? The same way a costume contest leaves you wondering who that incredible costume belonged to, NEAR shows you the people you passed but never met.
